pyproject.toml.text:
# pyproject.toml for voiage

[build-system]
requires = ["maturin>=1.9,<2.0"]
build-backend = "build_backend"
backend-path = ["."]

[project]
name = "voiage"
dynamic = ["version"]
description = "Value of Information analysis with a Rust core and Python, R, and Julia interfaces."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.15.1,<3.16"
license = "Apache-2.0"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
authors = [
  { name = "voiage Contributors", email = "voiage@users.noreply.github.com" },
]
keywords = [
    "voi", "value of information", "evpi", "evppi", "evsi", "enbs",
    "decision analysis", "health economics", "uncertainty quantification",
    "bayesian analysis", "cost-effectiveness"
]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable",
    "Intended Audience :: Science/Research",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Intended Audience :: Financial and Insurance Industry",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.15",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: Free Threading :: 2 - Beta",
    "Operating System :: OS Independent",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Mathematics",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Medical Science Apps.",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules",
]

dependencies = [
    "click>=8.3.3,<9",
    "numpy>=2.5.4,<3",
    "scipy>=1.18.1,<1.19",
    "pandas>=3.1.0,<4",
    "xarray>=2026.9.0,<2027",
    "scikit-learn>=1.9.1,<2",
    "pyarrow>=26.0.0,<27",
    "polars>=2.1.0,<3",
    "pydantic>=2.13.4,<3",
    "jsonschema>=4.26.0,<5.0",
    "typing_extensions>=4.16.0",
    "typer>=0.9,<1.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
# Local feedback experiments only; not a replacement for CI or coverage.
test-acceleration = [
    "pytest-testmon>=2.2.0,<3",
    "pytest-gremlins>=1.9.0,<2",
    "coverage>=7.16.0,<8",
    "vcrpy>=8.3.0,<9",
]
# The built-in descriptor adapters deliberately use only the base Arrow/JSON
# stack.  These named extras reserve stable installation surfaces for future
# enhanced validators without coupling them to the calculation runtime.
croissant = []
frictionless = []
ingestion = []
ecosystem = ["defusedxml>=0.7.1,<1.0"]
excel = ["python-calamine>=0.9.0,<0.10", "xlsxwriter>=3.3.0,<4", "defusedxml>=0.7.1,<1.0"]
docs = ["griffe>=1.14.0,<2.0"]
jax = [
    "jax>=0.12.0.1,<0.13",
]
ci = [
    "python-calamine>=0.9.0,<0.10",
    "xlsxwriter>=3.3.0,<4",
    "openpyxl>=3.1.5,<4.0",
    "defusedxml>=0.7.1,<1.0",
    "docutils>=0.23,<1",
    "fastapi>=0.139.2,<1.0",
    "httpx>=0.28.1,<1.0",
    "hypothesis>=6.157.0,<7.0",
    "jax>=0.12.0.1,<0.13",
    "matplotlib>=3.4,<4.0",
    "maturin>=1.9,<2.0",
    "psutil>=5.9,<8.0",
    "pytest>=9.1.1,<10.0",
    "pytest-benchmark>=5.2.3,<6.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0,<8.0",
    "pytest-integration>=0.2.3,<0.3",
    "pytest-xdist>=3.8.0,<4.0",
    "PyYAML>=6.0.3,<7.0",
    "rfc8785>=0.1,<0.2",
    "tomli>=2.4.1,<3.0",
]
dev = [
    "maturin>=1.9,<2.0",
    "mutmut==3.6.0",
    "scalene>=2.3.0,<3.0",
    "ruff>=0.17.2,<0.18",
    "bandit>=1.9.4,<2.0",
    "nox>=2026.7.11,<2027",
    "ty>=0.0.61,<1.0",
    "basedpyright>=1.39.9,<2.0",
    "types-setuptools>=83.0.0.20260716",
    "types-requests>=2.33.0.20260712",
    "jupyterlab>=4.6.2,<5.0",
    "ipykernel>=7.3.0,<8",
    "pre-commit>=4.6.0,<5.0",
    "vulture>=2.16,<3.0",
    "tox>=4.67,<5",
    "tox-uv>=1.37,<2",
    "tomli>=2.4.1,<3.0",
]
experimental = [
    "duckdb>=1.5.4,<2",
    "orjson>=3.11.9,<4",
    "msgspec>=0.21.1,<1",
]
plotting = [
    "matplotlib>=3.11.1,<4",
    "seaborn>=0.13.2,<1",
]
performance = ["psutil>=5.9,<8.0"]
# PyTorch currently has no CPython 3.15 wheels. Keep the installation name
# and APIs reserved; constructors report unavailability rather than changing engines.
deep_learning = []
web = ["fastapi>=0.139.2,<1.0", "httpx>=0.28.1,<1.0", "uvicorn>=0.51.0,<1.0"]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/edithatogo/voiage"
Documentation = "https://edithatogo.github.io/voiage"
Repository = "https://github.com/edithatogo/voiage"
Changelog = "https://github.com/edithatogo/voiage/blob/main/changelog.md"
Issues = "https://github.com/edithatogo/voiage/issues"

[project.scripts]
voiage = "voiage.cli:app"

# --- Tool Configurations ---

[tool.maturin]
manifest-path = "rust/crates/voiage-python/Cargo.toml"
python-source = "."
module-name = "voiage._core"
bindings = "pyo3"
features = ["pyo3/extension-module"]
locked = true
include = [
    { path = "build_backend.py", format = "sdist" },
    { path = "specs/**/*.json", format = "sdist" },
    { path = "rust/crates/voiage-python/source-provenance.txt", format = "sdist" },
]

# Generate the canonical CycloneDX SBOM in the supply-chain workflow. Maturin's
# per-wheel Cargo SBOM embeds temporary build paths, which would make otherwise
# identical wheels fail the reproducibility gate.
[tool.maturin.sbom]
rust = false

[tool.voiage.unavailable-extras.deep_learning]
engine = "PyTorch"
reason = "No CPython 3.15 wheels in the latest stable PyTorch 2.14.1 release"
observed = "2026-10-27"
api_retained = true
installation_available = false
fallback = "Select a supported scikit-learn metamodel explicitly"

[tool.voiage.release]
python-abi = "cp315-abi3"
architecture-policy = "native-runner"
supported-runners = ["ubuntu-24.04", "macos-14", "windows-2025"]
supported-native-architectures = ["linux-x86_64", "macos-arm64", "windows-x86_64"]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py315"
exclude = [
    "examples/",
]
# line-length = 88 # This is also a global setting, default is 88

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "F", "E", "W", "I", "C90", "N", "D", "ANN", "S", "B", "A", "PT", "RUF",
    "SIM", "C4", "RET", "SLF", "TRY", "RUF022", "RUF023", "PL", "FURB",
    "UP", "YTT", "ASYNC", "TCH", "PYI", "Q", "FA", "PERF"
]
ignore = [
    # Allowed: Any type is sometimes necessary for public APIs
    "ANN401",
    # DEFERRED → v1.1: Full type annotation coverage (563 manual fixes needed)
    "ANN001", "ANN002", "ANN003", "ANN201", "ANN202", "ANN204",
    # Line length handled by formatter
    "E501",
    # Assert statements needed in tests
    "S101",
    # Complexity limits - too strict for existing codebase
    "C901", "PLR0913", "PLR0917", "PLR0912", "PLR0915",
    # Exception message handling - stylistic
    "TRY003", "EM101", "EM102",
    # TODO/FIXME comments are useful
    "FIX002", "TD002", "TD003",
    # Private member access - internal module design choice
    "SLF001",
    # Magic value comparisons - stylistic, would require constants everywhere
    "PLR2004",
    # Import outside top-level - sometimes necessary for optional deps
    "PLC0415",
    # Variable naming in tests - non-lowercase common in pytest
    "N806",
]
per-file-ignores = { "tests/**/*.py" = [
    "B017",
    "D",
    "PT011",
    "PLW1510",
    "RUF043",
    "S110",
    "S603",
    "SIM105",
    "SIM117",
] }
fixable = ["ALL"]
unfixable = []

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["voiage"]
force-sort-within-sections = true

[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]
convention = "numpy"

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-annotations]
mypy-init-return = true
suppress-dummy-args = true

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"
skip-magic-trailing-comma = false
line-ending = "auto"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "8.0"
addopts = "-ra -q --cov-config=pyproject.toml"
testpaths = ["tests"]
python_files = "test_*.py"
markers = [
    "unit: marks tests as unit tests",
    "integration: marks tests as integration tests (deselect with '-m \"not integration\"')",
    "e2e: marks tests as end-to-end tests (deselect with '-m \"not e2e\"')",
    "slow: marks tests as slow (deselect with '-m \"not slow\"')",
    "benchmark: marks tests as benchmark tests"
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["voiage"]
branch = true

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
skip_covered = true
fail_under = 90
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "def __repr__",
    "raise AssertionError",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "@abstractmethod",
]

[tool.mutmut]
source_paths = ["voiage/"]
only_mutate = [
    "voiage/contracts/capabilities.py",
    "voiage/contracts/digests.py",
]
pytest_add_cli_args = ["-x", "--no-cov"]
pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection = [
    "tests/test_analysis_contracts.py",
    "tests/test_calculation_kernel.py",
    "tests/test_critical_invariants.py",
    "tests/test_mutation_score.py",
]
also_copy = ["scripts/"]

[tool.semantic_release]
version_source = "tag"
upload_to_pypi = true
upload_to_release = true
commit_message = "chore(release): {version} [skip ci]"
commit_author = "github-actions[bot] <actions@github.com>"
branch = "main"
changelog_file = "changelog.md"

[tool.taskipy.tasks]
test = "uv run pytest tests/ -m 'not integration and not e2e and not benchmark' --cov=voiage --cov-report=term-missing"
test-integration = "uv run pytest tests/ -m 'integration' --no-cov"
test-e2e = "uv run pytest tests/ -m 'e2e' --no-cov"
test-all = "uv run pytest tests/ --cov=voiage --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=html"
frontier-contract = "uv run python scripts/validate_frontier_contract.py"
contracts = "uv run nox -s contracts"
contracts-profile = "uv run nox -s contract_profile"
contracts-mutation = "uv run nox -s contract_mutation"
lint = "tox -e lint"
vale = "bash scripts/vale_prose.sh"
format = "uv run ruff format voiage tests"
typecheck = "tox -e typecheck"
security = "uv run ruff check voiage --select=S --ignore=S101"
harness = "python scripts/repo_harness.py"
profile = "uv run scalene run --use-legacy-tracer --cpu-only -o profile_results.json profile_scalene.py"
mutmut = "uv run mutmut run"
benchmark = "uv run pytest tests/ -m 'benchmark' --benchmark-only --no-cov"
docs = "cd docs/astro-site && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run check && pnpm run build"
precommit = "uv run pre-commit run --all-files"
check = "tox"
nox = "uv run nox"
build = "uv build"
publish-test = "uv publish --publish-url https://test.pypi.org/legacy/"
publish = "uv publish"
conda-build = "conda-build conda-recipe/ --python 3.15.1"
refresh-registry-audit = "python scripts/refresh_binding_registry_audit.py"
arxiv-readiness = "python scripts/build_arxiv_submission.py"
arxiv-validate = "python scripts/validate_arxiv_manifest.py && python scripts/validate_arxiv.py paper"
arxiv-variants = ".venv-arxiv/bin/python scripts/prepare_arxiv_variants.py"
arxiv-readability = "NLTK_DATA=.venv-arxiv/nltk_data .venv-arxiv/bin/python scripts/audit_arxiv_readability.py build/arxiv/main.pdf build/arxiv/readability.json"
joss-validate = "python scripts/validate_joss.py"

conda-recipe/meta.yaml.text:
{% set name = "voiage" %}
{% set version = "2.1.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f0844694c628a92d29a532170f5a5672acfe210efe1d797359a4dc18c11ab901

build:
  number: 0
  skip: true  # [py<312]
  entry_points:
    - voiage = voiage.cli:main

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('rust') }}
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - maturin >=1.9,<2.0
  run:
    - python
    - click >=8.3.3,<9
    - numpy >=2.2.6,<3.0
    - scipy >=1.16.3,<1.17
    - pandas >=1.3,<3.0
    - xarray >=0.19,<2025.0
    - scikit-learn >=1.7.2,<2.0
    - pyarrow >=25.0.0,<26
    - polars >=1.42.1,<2
    - pydantic >=2.13.4,<3
    - typing_extensions >=4.16.0
    - typer >=0.9,<1.0

test:
  imports:
    - voiage
    - voiage._core
    - voiage.analysis
    - voiage.schema
  commands:
    - pip check
    - voiage --help
    - python -c "import numpy as np; import voiage; import voiage._core as core; assert core.runtime_info()['core_version'] == voiage.__version__; assert abs(voiage.evpi(np.array([[10.0, 12.0], [11.0, 9.0], [13.0, 14.0]])) - (2.0 / 3.0)) < 1e-12"
  requires:
    - python
    - pip

about:
  home: https://github.com/edithatogo/voiage
  summary: Rust-centred Value of Information analysis with Python bindings
  description: |
    voiage helps researchers and decision-makers quantify the expected value
    of reducing uncertainty. This conda package provides the Python interface
    to its Rust-backed numerical core, including EVPI, EVPPI, EVSI, ENBS,
    decision-frontier, and structural-uncertainty methods.
  dev_url: https://github.com/edithatogo/voiage
  doc_url: https://edithatogo.github.io/voiage
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  license_family: Apache

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - edithatogo

conda-recipe/README.md.text:
# voiage conda-forge Recipe

This is the sole Conda recipe for the native Maturin package and the handoff
source for publishing voiage to conda-forge. The release workflow replaces its
version and source hash only after the immutable PyPI sdist is published.

## Building the conda package

To build the conda package locally:

```bash
# Install conda-build
conda install -n base conda-build

# Build the package
conda build conda-recipe

# Install the built package
conda install -c local voiage
```

## Publishing to conda-forge

To publish to conda-forge:

1. Fork the [conda-forge/staged-recipes](https://github.com/conda-forge/staged-recipes) repository
2. Copy this recipe directory to `recipes/voiage` in the forked repository
3. Submit a pull request to `conda-forge/staged-recipes`; the recipe is pinned
   to the published `voiage 1.0.0` sdist and its verified SHA256 hash.

## Recipe Structure

- `meta.yaml`: Main recipe file with package metadata and dependencies

## Dependencies

The recipe specifies the following dependencies:

### Host Dependencies
- python >=3.12
- pip
- maturin >=1.9,<2.0
- a conda-forge Rust compiler

### Run Dependencies
- python >=3.12
- click, numpy, scipy, pandas, xarray, scikit-learn
- pyarrow, polars, pydantic, typing_extensions, typer

## Testing

The recipe includes tests to verify:
- Package imports correctly
- Command-line interface works
- All required dependencies are properly specified

tox.ini.text:
[tox]
requires =
    tox>=4.67,<5
    tox-uv>=1.37,<2
env_list =
    lint
    vale
    joss
    harness
    typecheck
    docs
    ingestion-conformance
    frontier-contract
    version-sync
    py315
    min_versions
    max_versions
    coverage_report
skip_missing_interpreters = false
env_runner = uv-venv-runner

[testenv]
base_python = python3.15
description = Run pytest tests with {envname}
commands_pre = python -c "import sys; assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 15, 1), sys.version"
# Build the test wheel directly from the authenticated checkout. The dedicated
# release contract separately rebuilds the sdist with its injected immutable
# source identity; a generic tox-created archive cannot carry that identity.
package = wheel
pass_env =
    VOIAGE_TEST_UV_CACHE_DIR
    TMPDIR
extras =
    jax
deps =
    defusedxml<1.0,>=0.7.1
    hypothesis<7.0,>=6.157.0
    pytest<10.0,>=9.1.1
    rfc8785<0.2,>=0.1
    PyYAML>=6.0.3,<7
set_env =
    MPLBACKEND = Agg
    OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1
    OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1
    MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1
    NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS = 1
    POLARS_MAX_THREADS = 1
commands =
    pytest -o addopts='' {posargs:tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py tests/test_core_metrics_regression.py tests/test_contract_bundle.py tests/test_v2_stable_api_contract.py tests/test_v3_stable_api_contract.py tests/test_schema_polars_surface.py tests/test_polars_numerical_parity.py tests/test_python_runtime_policy.py tests/test_version_sync.py tests/test_dataframe_interchange_sdk.py tests/test_python_rust_bridge.py tests/test_cli_expected_utility_information.py}

[testenv:lint]
description = Run linters and formatters
skip_install = true
deps =
    bandit<2.0,>=1.7
    ruff<0.18,>=0.17.2
commands =
    ruff check voiage tests --fix --exit-non-zero-on-fix
    ruff format voiage tests --check
    bandit -r voiage -s B101,B110,B405,B314 -c pyproject.toml

[testenv:vale]
description = Run the repository prose linter
skip_install = true
allowlist_externals =
    bash
commands =
    bash scripts/vale_prose.sh

[testenv:joss]
description = Validate the JOSS manuscript and submission package
skip_install = true
deps =
    pytest<10.0,>=9.1.1
    PyYAML<7.0,>=6.0.3
commands =
    python scripts/validate_joss.py
    pytest -o addopts='' --noconftest tests/test_joss_readiness.py -q

[testenv:harness]
description = Run repository quality and workflow security harness
skip_install = true
deps =
    .[ci]
commands =
    python scripts/repo_harness.py
    pytest tests/test_repo_harness.py --no-cov -q

[testenv:typecheck]
description = Run static type checking with ty
skip_install = true
deps =
    matplotlib>=3.11.1
    numpy>=2.5.1
    pandas>=3.0.3
    scikit-learn>=1.9.0
    seaborn>=0.13.2
    statsmodels>=0.14.6
    ty<1.0,>=0.0.1
    typer>=0.27.0
    types-setuptools
    xarray>=2026.7.0
commands =
    ty check voiage --python-version=3.15 --ignore invalid-argument-type --ignore invalid-assignment --ignore unresolved-attribute --ignore unresolved-import --ignore no-matching-overload --ignore unsupported-operator --ignore call-non-callable --ignore not-iterable --ignore not-subscriptable --ignore invalid-return-type --ignore invalid-method-override --ignore unused-type-ignore-comment --ignore redundant-cast {posargs}

[testenv:docs]
description = Check and build the Astro/Starlight documentation site
skip_install = true
deps =
    .[docs]
set_env =
    STARLIGHT_POLYGLOT_PYTHON = {envpython}
changedir = docs/astro-site
allowlist_externals = pnpm
commands =
    python ../../scripts/validate_astro_docs.py ../..
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    pnpm run check
    pnpm exec astro build

[testenv:ingestion-conformance]
description = Run the canonical standardized-ingestion conformance matrix
commands =
    pytest -o addopts='' tests/test_standardized_ingestion_conformance.py tests/test_standardized_ingestion_fixture_validator.py tests/test_standardized_ingestion_reference_cases.py -q

[testenv:frontier-contract]
commands =
    python scripts/validate_frontier_contract.py
base = frontier-contract-base

[testenv:version-sync]
description = Validate canonical version synchronization across package manifests
skip_install = true
deps =
    .[ci]
commands =
    python scripts/validate_version_sync.py

[testenv:min_versions]
description = Test the qualified scientific and tabular dependency floors
base_python = python3.15
deps =
    defusedxml<1.0,>=0.7.1
    hypothesis<7.0,>=6.157.0
    numpy==2.5.4
    PyYAML>=6.0.3,<7
    pandas==3.1.0
    pytest<10.0,>=9.1.1
    rfc8785<0.2,>=0.1
    scipy==1.18.1
    polars==2.1.0
    pyarrow==26.0.0
commands =
    pytest -o addopts='' {posargs:tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py tests/test_core_metrics_regression.py tests/test_contract_bundle.py tests/test_v2_stable_api_contract.py tests/test_v3_stable_api_contract.py tests/test_schema_polars_surface.py tests/test_polars_numerical_parity.py tests/test_python_runtime_policy.py tests/test_version_sync.py tests/test_dataframe_interchange_sdk.py tests/test_python_rust_bridge.py tests/test_cli_expected_utility_information.py}

[testenv:max_versions]
description = Test with maximum dependency versions
deps =
    defusedxml<1.0,>=0.7.1
    hypothesis<7.0,>=6.157.0
    numpy<3,>=2.5.4
    PyYAML>=6.0.3,<7
    pandas<4,>=3.1.0
    pytest<10.0,>=9.1.1
    rfc8785<0.2,>=0.1
    scikit-learn<2,>=1.9.0
    scipy<1.19,>=1.18.1
commands =
    pytest -o addopts='' {posargs:tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py tests/test_core_metrics_regression.py tests/test_contract_bundle.py tests/test_v2_stable_api_contract.py tests/test_v3_stable_api_contract.py tests/test_schema_polars_surface.py tests/test_polars_numerical_parity.py tests/test_python_runtime_policy.py tests/test_version_sync.py tests/test_dataframe_interchange_sdk.py tests/test_python_rust_bridge.py tests/test_cli_expected_utility_information.py}

[testenv:coverage_report]
description = Generate and check code coverage report
extras =
    ci
commands =
    pytest tests/ -n 2 --dist=worksteal --cov=voiage --cov-config=pyproject.toml --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html --cov-fail-under=90 # Generate and verify coverage in the same environment as local development
allowlist_externals =
    uv

[frontier-contract-base]
description = Validate the frontier VOI registry and family manifests
skip_install = true
deps =
    jsonschema>=4

[testenv:safety]
description = Run safety check for dependency vulnerabilities
deps =
    safety>=2.3
    pip-tools>=7.0
allowlist_externals =
    rm
commands =

scripts/dependency_frontier.py.text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit declared dependencies without confusing support floors with the lock."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tomllib
import urllib.request

from packaging.requirements import Requirement
from packaging.utils import canonicalize_name
from packaging.version import InvalidVersion, Version


def declared_requirements(config: dict[str, object]) -> list[tuple[str, Requirement]]:
    """Collect core, optional, development, and build dependency declarations."""
    project = config["project"]
    assert isinstance(project, dict)
    grouped: list[tuple[str, object]] = [("core", project.get("dependencies", []))]
    optional = project.get("optional-dependencies", {})
    assert isinstance(optional, dict)
    grouped.extend((f"optional:{name}", values) for name, values in optional.items())
    dependency_groups = config.get("dependency-groups", {})
    assert isinstance(dependency_groups, dict)
    grouped.extend(
        (f"group:{name}", values) for name, values in dependency_groups.items()
    )
    build_system = config.get("build-system", {})
    assert isinstance(build_system, dict)
    grouped.append(("build", build_system.get("requires", [])))
    requirements: list[tuple[str, Requirement]] = []
    for scope, values in grouped:
        assert isinstance(values, list)
        requirements.extend(
            (scope, Requirement(item)) for item in values if isinstance(item, str)
        )
    return requirements


def release_metadata(name: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Return release metadata from the official PyPI JSON API."""
    url = f"https://pypi.org/pypi/{name}/json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=20) as response:  # noqa: S310 -- fixed HTTPS PyPI endpoint
        payload = json.load(response)
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    return payload


def minimum_declared(requirement: Requirement) -> str | None:
    """Return the strongest declared inclusive lower bound."""
    candidates = [
        Version(spec.version)
        for spec in requirement.specifier
        if spec.operator in {">=", "=="} and "*" not in spec.version
    ]
    return str(max(candidates)) if candidates else None


def locked_versions(lock: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """Index every exact version in the uv lock by normalized package name."""
    result: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    packages = lock.get("package", [])
    assert isinstance(packages, list)
    for package in packages:
        assert isinstance(package, dict)
        name = package.get("name")
        version = package.get("version")
        if isinstance(name, str) and isinstance(version, str):
            result.setdefault(canonicalize_name(name), set()).add(version)
    return {name: sorted(versions, key=Version) for name, versions in result.items()}


def usable_versions(releases: object) -> list[Version]:
    """Return sorted non-yanked final releases with valid PEP 440 versions."""
    if not isinstance(releases, dict):
        return []
    versions: list[Version] = []
    for raw_version, files in releases.items():
        try:
            version = Version(str(raw_version))
        except InvalidVersion:
            continue
        if version.is_prerelease or version.is_devrelease:
            continue
        if (
            isinstance(files, list)
            and files
            and all(
                isinstance(file, dict) and file.get("yanked", False) for file in files
            )
        ):
            continue
        versions.append(version)
    return sorted(set(versions))


def newest(values: list[Version]) -> str | None:
    """Serialize the newest version in an iterable."""
    versions = list(values)
    return str(max(versions)) if versions else None


def audit_requirement(
    scope: str,
    requirement: Requirement,
    lock_index: dict[str, list[str]],
    metadata: dict[str, object],
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Report support floor, lock, and release frontier as distinct facts."""
    versions = usable_versions(metadata.get("releases"))
    compatible = [version for version in versions if version in requirement.specifier]
    latest_overall = newest(versions)
    latest_compatible = newest(compatible)
    locked = lock_index.get(canonicalize_name(requirement.name), [])
    locked_satisfy = bool(locked) and all(
        Version(version) in requirement.specifier for version in locked
    )
    violations: list[str] = []
    if not locked:
        violations.append("missing_from_lock")
    elif not locked_satisfy:
        violations.append("locked_version_outside_declared_range")
    if latest_compatible is None:
        violations.append("no_compatible_final_release")

    if violations:
        support_window = "policy_violation"
    elif latest_compatible in locked:
        support_window = "locked_at_latest_compatible"
    else:
        support_window = "locked_within_supported_range"

    return {
        "scope": scope,
        "package": requirement.name,
        "specifier": str(requirement.specifier),
        "minimum_supported": minimum_declared(requirement),
        "locked": locked,
        "latest_compatible": latest_compatible,
        "latest_overall": latest_overall,
        "upper_bound_blocker": bool(
            latest_overall
            and latest_compatible
            and latest_overall != latest_compatible
            and Version(latest_overall) not in requirement.specifier
        ),
        "prereleases_allowed": requirement.specifier.prereleases is True,
        "support_window_status": support_window,
        "policy_violations": violations,
    }


def main() -> int:
    """Run the live dependency audit and write local context artifacts."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("repo", type=Path, nargs="?", default=Path.cwd())
    parser.add_argument("--strict", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    repo = args.repo.resolve()
    config = tomllib.loads((repo / "pyproject.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    lock = tomllib.loads((repo / "uv.lock").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    requirements = declared_requirements(config)
    lock_index = locked_versions(lock)
    rows = [
        audit_requirement(
            scope, requirement, lock_index, release_metadata(requirement.name)
        )
        for scope, requirement in requirements
    ]
    violations = [
        {
            "scope": row["scope"],
            "package": row["package"],
            "reasons": row["policy_violations"],
        }
        for row in rows
        if row["policy_violations"]
    ]
    report = {
        "schema_version": "2.0",
        "requires_python": config["project"].get("requires-python"),
        "strict_policy_passed": not violations,
        "policy_violations": violations,
        "dependencies": rows,
    }
    output = repo / ".conductor" / "local"
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (output / "dependency_frontier.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    lines = [
        "# Dependency frontier",
        "",
        f"Python: `{report['requires_python']}`",
        f"Strict dependency policy: **{'pass' if report['strict_policy_passed'] else 'fail'}**",
        "",
        "| Scope | Package | Minimum supported | Locked | Latest compatible | Latest overall | Upper-bound preview | Policy |",
        "|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|:---:|:---:|",
    ]
    lines.extend(
        "| `{scope}` | `{package}` | `{minimum_supported}` | `{locked}` | "
        "`{latest_compatible}` | `{latest_overall}` | {upper} | {policy} |".format(
            **row,
            upper="yes" if row["upper_bound_blocker"] else "no",
            policy="pass" if not row["policy_violations"] else "fail",
        )
        for row in rows
    )
    (output / "dependency_frontier.md").write_text(
        "\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    print(output / "dependency_frontier.md")
    return 2 if args.strict and violations else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

.github/workflows/dependency-frontier.ym.text:
name: Dependency Assurance

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 5 * * 1'


# Cancel obsolete pull-request runs while preserving independent main, schedule, and manual runs.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  stable-frozen:
    name: Stable Frozen Lock
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pinned uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@11f9893b081a58869d3b5fccaea48c9e9e46f990
        with:
          version: "0.13.6"
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1
        with:
          python-version: "3.15.1"

      - name: Install the immutable stable environment
        run: uv sync --frozen --extra ci

      - name: Verify immutable lock
        run: uv lock --check

      - name: Run stable assurance contracts
        run: >-
          uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest
          tests/test_contract_bundle.py
          tests/test_logging_contract.py
          tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py
          --no-cov -q

      - name: Apply lock-derived runtime licence policy
        run: scripts/run_python_license_audit.sh

  latest-compatible-frontier:
    name: Latest Compatible and Experimental Observation
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    continue-on-error: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      UV_MALWARE_CHECK: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pinned uv resolver
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@11f9893b081a58869d3b5fccaea48c9e9e46f990
        with:
          version: "0.13.6"
          enable-cache: false

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1
        with:
          python-version: "3.15.1"

      - name: Resolve latest versions within declared constraints
        id: resolve
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          uv lock --upgrade
          uv sync --extra ci --extra experimental
          uv tree --depth 1

      - name: Run frontier assurance contracts
        id: contracts
        continue-on-error: true
        run: >-
          uv run --no-sync pytest
          tests/test_contract_bundle.py
          tests/test_logging_contract.py
          tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py
          --no-cov -q

      - name: Record frontier drift
        id: audit
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          git diff -- uv.lock > dependency-frontier.patch
          uv run --no-sync python scripts/dependency_frontier.py . --strict

      - name: Record frontier outcomes
        if: always()
        env:
          RESOLUTION_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.resolve.outcome }}
          CONTRACTS_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.contracts.outcome }}
          AUDIT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.audit.outcome }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          evidence = {
              "schema_version": "1.0.0",
              "resolution": os.environ["RESOLUTION_OUTCOME"],
              "contracts": os.environ["CONTRACTS_OUTCOME"],
              "audit": os.environ["AUDIT_OUTCOME"],
          }
          Path("dependency-frontier-summary.json").write_text(
              json.dumps(evidence, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
              encoding="utf-8",
          )
          PY

      - name: Upload observational frontier evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: dependency-frontier-observation
          path: |
            dependency-frontier-summary.json
            dependency-frontier.patch
            .conductor/local/dependency_frontier.json
            .conductor/local/dependency_frontier.md
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Require successful frontier observation
        if: always()
        env:
          RESOLUTION_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.resolve.outcome }}
          CONTRACTS_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.contracts.outcome }}
          AUDIT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.audit.outcome }}
        run: |
          echo "resolution: ${RESOLUTION_OUTCOME}"
          echo "contracts: ${CONTRACTS_OUTCOME}"
          echo "audit: ${AUDIT_OUTCOME}"
          if [ "${RESOLUTION_OUTCOME}" != success ] || [ "${CONTRACTS_OUTCOME}" != success ] || [ "${AUDIT_OUTCOME}" != success ]; then
            exit 1
          fi

.github/workflows/dependency-preview.yml.text:
name: Dependency and CI Preview Observations

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "41 4 1 * *"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: dependency-preview-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  major-dependency-observation:
    name: Preview ${{ matrix.id }}
    continue-on-error: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: scipy-current
            requirement: scipy>=1.18,<1.19
            command: pytest tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py tests/test_core_metrics_regression.py --no-cov -q
          - id: pandas-current
            requirement: pandas>=3,<4
            command: pytest tests/test_dataframe_interchange_sdk.py tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py --no-cov -q
          - id: xarray-current
            requirement: xarray>=2026.7,<2027
            command: pytest tests/test_dataframe_interchange_sdk.py tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py --no-cov -q
          - id: griffe-2
            requirement: griffe>=2.2,<3
            command: pytest tests/test_api_reference_docs.py tests/test_astro_docs_contract.py --no-cov -q
          - id: jax-current
            requirement: jax[cpu]>=0.12.0.1,<0.13
            command: pytest tests/test_backends.py tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py --no-cov -q
          - id: ruff-current
            requirement: ruff>=0.17.2,<0.18
            command: ruff check voiage tests scripts
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact source
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install pinned uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@11f9893b081a58869d3b5fccaea48c9e9e46f990
        with:
          version: "0.13.6"
          enable-cache: false
      - name: Set up stable Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1
        with:
          python-version: "3.15.1"
      - name: Install frozen stable reference environment
        run: uv sync --frozen --extra ci --extra experimental
      - name: Overlay one isolated preview candidate
        run: uv pip install --python .venv --upgrade --resolution highest "${{ matrix.requirement }}"
      - name: Verify resolved environment
        run: |
          set +e
          uv pip check --python .venv 2>&1 | tee dependency-preview-metadata-check.txt
          metadata_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          set -e
          echo "metadata_check_exit_code=${metadata_status}" >> dependency-preview-metadata-check.txt
          uv pip freeze --python .venv > dependency-preview-freeze.txt
      - name: Run candidate-specific compatibility and fallback checks
        run: uv run --frozen --no-sync ${{ matrix.command }}
      - name: Upload observational resolution
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: dependency-preview-${{ matrix.id }}
          path: |
            dependency-preview-freeze.txt
            dependency-preview-metadata-check.txt
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  python-prerelease-observation:
    name: Python 3.15.1 qualification
    continue-on-error: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@11f9893b081a58869d3b5fccaea48c9e9e46f990
        with:
          version: "0.13.6"
          enable-cache: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1
        with:
          python-version: "3.15.1"
      - name: Observe prerelease compatibility without publishing artifacts
        run: |
          uv sync --extra ci
          uv run --no-sync pytest tests/test_numerical_reference_cases.py tests/test_contract_bundle.py --no-cov -q

  deterministic-python-shards:
    name: Deterministic Python shard ${{ matrix.shard }} of 2
    continue-on-error: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@11f9893b081a58869d3b5fccaea48c9e9e46f990
        with:
          version: "0.13.6"
          enable-cache: true
          cache-suffix: preview-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1
        with:
          python-version: "3.15.1"
      - name: Install frozen test environment
        run: uv sync --frozen --extra ci
      - name: Run one stable deterministic partition
        run: >-
          uv run pytest tests/
          -m "not integration and not e2e and not benchmark"
          --no-cov --numprocesses=4 --dist=worksteal -q
        env:
          CI: true
          VOIAGE_TEST_SHARD_INDEX: ${{ matrix.shard }}
          VOIAGE_TEST_SHARD_COUNT: 2

  rust-acceleration-observation:
    name: cargo-nextest and sccache observation
    continue-on-error: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: sccache
      SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED: "true"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select qualified Python runtime
        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1
        with:
          python-version: "3.15.1"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@2c7215f132e9ebf062739d9130488b56d53c060c
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Configure the pinned GitHub Actions sccache backend
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@d651010b8da762cde178750d8eda7b5febfe147a
        with:
          version: "v0.12.0"
      - name: Install pinned preview accelerators
        run: env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER cargo install --locked cargo-nextest --version 0.9.114
      - name: Run the non-authoritative nextest inventory
        working-directory: rust
        run: cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --locked --no-fail-fast
      - name: Record cache statistics
        if: always()
        run: sccache --show-stats

boundary: Remove published/runtime pandas and xarray requirements; retain pandas only in an explicit unpublished producer-tests dependency group. uv defaults exclude that group; CI and tox opt in for actual external-producer/oracle tests. Base wheel/no-extras closure must contain neither package. No Voiage shim or fallback. Whole-repository references remain Phase 7.
conda_source_boundary: Keep published source version/hash immutable. The recipe dependency block targets the next migrated release; retargeting/building/publishing that release remains a separate gate. Do not claim the old published sdist is pandas-free.
verification_commands: guard -- uv lock --upgrade; guard -- python scripts/dependency_frontier.py . --strict
guard -- clean wheel install without extras and inspect dependency closure/sys.modules
